title: JavaScript: decisions and loops
bridge: `if (x > 5) { ... } else if (...) { ... } else { ... }`; and/or/not are `&&`, `||`, `!`. Loops: `for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++)`, `while (cond)`, and `for (const item of list)` for every item (note: **of**, not in).

notes: Guard bad input first, then highest grade down.
Build an array of lines and join.

exercises.title: Fridge check
exercises.prompt: Write fridge(temp): "too cold" below 2, "ok" from 2 to 8 (both included), "too warm" above 8.

exercises.title: Times table
exercises.prompt: Write timesTable(n) that returns an ARRAY of 12 strings like "7 x 3 = 21" (from 1 to 12).

exercises.title: Count the vowels
exercises.prompt: Write countVowels(text): how many a, e, i, o, u (capitals count too). Use a for…of loop.

quiz.why: of gives the items; in gives positions.

quiz.q: Build up an array in a loop?

explain: Explain javascript: decisions and loops to someone who has never programmed, in your own words, with an example you make up.
